shared_elements: anthropomorphic human figure carved in relief
justification: Both depict human figures with distinct headgear carved in relief, and both include disc-like circular forms and horizontal dividing bands, but these are generic to almost any figural relief tradition. A is a single frontal, highly schematic monolithic figure with symbols laid on the body (a large ring/disc at the chest, curved bands below), while B is a naturalistic horizontal procession of profile figures in crested helmets carrying objects beneath an inscribed register — different figural conventions, orientation and compositional logic.
